verses.t: “Tayome, bhikkhave, āsavā. Katame tayo? Kāmāsavo, bhavāsavo, avijjāsavo— ime kho, bhikkhave, tayo āsavā”ti. Etamatthaṁ bhagavā avoca. Tatthetaṁ iti vuccati:
“Samāhito sampajāno, sato buddhassa sāvako; Āsave ca pajānāti, āsavānañca sambhavaṁ.
Yattha cetā nirujjhanti, maggañca khayagāminaṁ; Āsavānaṁ khayā bhikkhu, nicchāto parinibbuto”ti.
Ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā, iti me sutanti. Sattamaṁ.
